items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: I was, if there had been things that had been improved, I was going back to New Orleans. So he told me, he said, well, you will be the last of the New Orleans musicians I'll ever send for.

ctx.x: Right after I came out of the Army. I went back to Detroit. Then I came back to New Orleans in 1948. The latter part of 48. And, uh, uh, uh, uh, with, uh, with Joe, it, it, it, it just seem as if he, as if he had just said, well, just let it all go. Mm-hmm. And, uh, it wasn't good for his business. Wasn't good for his business. And, uh, he was having trouble with his stomach. And that was because of, uh, he had bad teeth. Mm-hmm. And Louis gave him the money three times to have his teeth fixed. The king would not…
Did he have trouble with his lip much in those times?
